decision: We will enqueue the classification job by an AFTER INSERT trigger on intake_messages (same transaction) and wake the in-process worker with notify_enqueued.

decision: We will seed registry row assistant.classificador_agendamento (claude-haiku-5-5) with a first-draft prompt via migration ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, per core 113 precedent.
options_considered: no repo copy, hand the text to the owner to paste in the registry UI (classifier refuses until then); core migration instead of assistant

decision: We will render the seed ai_outputs organ table, then withdraw its browser policy+grant (service role only, Assistant posture) and add the unique (row, prompt_version, model) key.

decision: We will not start the worker without an ENFORCED LLM_SPEND_LIMITS entry covering it; rows stay pending with text, instead of being skipped_budget en masse.
options_considered: run and mark every row skipped_budget (destroys the text: skipped clears body and is terminal)

decision: We will parse the model answer strictly (one JSON object, 3 keys, extra=forbid, reason/boolean coherence; a ```json fence is the only tolerance); text cut at 4000 chars.

decision: We will keep the body after classification until retain_until (S2's 015 says body kept while pending|classified|failed); replay and S4 labelling need it.

decision: We will keep the body on skipped_budget (until retain_until) and make it non-terminal: 017 redefines set_intake_outcome; replay accepts skipped_budget rows (tech-lead).
options_considered: 015 behaviour: skipped_budget clears body + terminal (a budget outage destroys data permanently) - rejected by tech-lead review of ef50efc91
